key_findings: BOT2: admission must distinguish existence, binding/authorization, and usable evidence; coordination consensus has no gate authority.
BOT3: coordination references cannot establish freshness; local evaluator must resolve exact-current evidence.
BOT4: admission receipts need independent binding to unique run identity and exact runtime/deployment instance to prevent replay across runtimes.
synthesis: BOT4's replay-gap challenge is accepted as a blocking design constraint to investigate. BOT3 freshness/lineage and BOT4 runtime identity are complementary. No deliberation record may itself establish forensic truth.
